title: Nutrient-rich Croatian Cheese Pilaf
description: A delicious and healthy Croatian-inspired dish featuring salted butter, cheese, and low-glycemic-friendly ingredients.

ingredients.name: unsalted butter
ingredients.notes: salted butter is also fine, use as needed

instructions: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C) and a comal or skillet on medium-high heat.
Add 1 tablespoon of butter to the comal and toast the bread until crispy and golden brown.
Remove the bread from the comal and set aside.
Add the remaining 1 tablespoon of butter to the comal and sauté the mushrooms until they release their moisture and start to brown.
Add the diced chicken to the comal and cook until browned and cooked through.
Add the diced onion and minced garlic to the comal and cook until the onion is translucent.
Stir in the shredded cheese and cook until melted and well combined with the mushroom and chicken mixture.
Add the toasted bread to the comal and stir until the bread is evenly coated with the cheesy mixture.
Transfer the comal to the preheated oven and bake for 8-10 minutes, or until the top is golden brown and crispy.
Remove the comal from the oven and let cool for a few minutes before serving.
